Across the over 1,000 matches at the 23 tournaments of the FIFA World Cup, 58 hat-tricks have been scored. The only World Cup not to have at least one hat-trick scored was the 2006 FIFA World Cup in Germany. The record number of hat-tricks in a single World Cup tournament is eight, during the 1954 FIFA World Cup in Switzerland.
